scope.description: Whole shotcut application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Timeline/media editing, multi-track composition, audio, transitions, effects, colour, captions and export.

coverage.rationale: Basic timeline assembly is useful, but the majority of a full editor remains inaccessible.

scope.description: Explicit source trims, order and repetitions to one editable silent timeline and FFV1 render.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Named assets and frame ranges hide MLT setup and rendering, but the user still describes individual cuts and order.

limitations: One contiguous silent track; no gaps, transitions, audio, subtitles, scaling or rotation; bounded sources and frames.

Editorial estimate from current contracts, guidance and completion evidence; no exhaustive native API denominator or new native acceptance was measured for this assessment. Qualification and runtime availability must be queried separately.
